limitations.note: Instead of correcting only the beverage-2 output codes at 2.5 and 3 yuan, the agent replaced the FSM with a design that changes how held or simultaneous coin inputs are counted and can extend change dispensing across cycles.

limitations.quote: change = max(0, pending + (balance - price if vend else 0) - 1)
limitations.note: The test used the rewrite’s own change-queue and coin-edge rules as its oracle, so passing 440 transitions did not establish that the original FSM behavior was preserved.
The agent enumerated reachable states to size a new change queue and then revised its arithmetic, work the two output-code corrections did not require.

limitations.quote: check every per-state output assignment before changing transition or counter logic
limitations.note: The agent read advice directly relevant to this output-table defect but did not use it to constrain the patch.
